matching = sorted(f for f in files if fnmatch.fnmatch(f, '*-*.md') and f != 'README.md')

rows = []
for f in matching:
    with open(f'/inputs/{f}', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        content = fh.read()
    title = None
    for line in content.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('# '):
            title = line[2:].strip()
            break
    rows.append((f, title))

with open('/inputs/README.md', 'rb') as f:
    original_text = f.read().decode('utf-8')

table_lines = ['| File | Type | Description |', '| --- | --- | --- |']
for f, title in rows:
    table_lines.append(f'| [{f}](../inputs/{f}) | .md | {title} |')

appended = '\n## Reference index\n\n' + '\n'.join(table_lines) + '\n'
final_text = original_text + appended

with open('/work/README.md', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
    fh.write(final_text)
